theorems.name: Submission.dorag_tes_gv_adapted_frame
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (P : Euclid (n + k) →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v, ι v ∈ T) → (∀ v, P (ι v) = v) → (∀ w, P (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ (u : Euclid n) (y : Euclid (n + k)), inner ℝ (ι u) y = inner ℝ u (P y)) ∧ (∀ y, T.starProjection y = ι (P y)) ∧ (∀ w, ι' w ∈ Tᗮ) ∧ (∀ y, ‖y‖ ^ 2 = ‖P y‖ ^ 2 + ‖y - T.starProjection y‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ y, ‖P y‖ ≤ ‖y‖)
